questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: In an isochoric process, in which the volume of the gas is kept constant:
options: No work is done, so all the heat supplied changes the internal energy
questions.explanation: W = PΔV = 0 when the volume is fixed, so the first law reduces to Q = ΔU. A pressure cooker heating with its lid shut is close to this process.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: According to kinetic theory, the pressure exerted by an ideal gas of density ρ whose molecules have a mean square speed c² is:
questions.explanation: P = ⅓ρc², the one third arising because molecular motion is shared equally among the three directions in space.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Two identical cells, each of emf E and internal resistance r, are joined in series across an external resistance R. The current in the circuit is:
questions.explanation: In series the emfs add and so do the internal resistances, so I = 2E/(R + 2r). A series grouping is useful when R is much larger than r.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.topic: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
questions.question: Among the elements of period 3, the one with the largest atomic radius is:
questions.explanation: Atomic radius decreases from left to right across a period, so the first element of the period, sodium, is the largest and chlorine the smallest.
questions.ncertReference: Chemistry Class 11, Chapter 3: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Adding a catalyst to a reversible reaction already at equilibrium will:
options: Shift the equilibrium towards the products
Not change the position of equilibrium, but help it be reached faster
Increase the value of the equilibrium constant
questions.explanation: A catalyst lowers the activation energy of the forward and the backward reaction by the same amount, so both speed up equally and the equilibrium constant is untouched.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The conversion of benzene diazonium chloride into chlorobenzene using cuprous chloride and HCl is called the:
questions.explanation: The diazonium group is an excellent leaving group, which makes it the standard route to aryl halides, cyanides and phenols that cannot be made by direct substitution.

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: Cells that have stopped dividing and have left the cell cycle to stay metabolically active in a resting state are said to be in:
questions.explanation: Nerve cells and heart muscle cells stay in G₀ permanently, which is why such tissue repairs itself so poorly after injury.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 10: Cell Cycle and Cell Division

questions.subject: Botany
questions.question: The kangaroo rat of the North American desert meets almost all its water needs by:
options: Internal oxidation of its fat, and by passing nearly solid urine
questions.explanation: Metabolic water from fat breakdown plus an extremely concentrated urine lets it survive without drinking at all, a classic physiological adaptation to desert life.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 12, Chapter 11: Organisms and Populations

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: The total number of vertebrae in the vertebral column of an adult human is:
questions.explanation: A child starts with 33, but the five sacral and four coccygeal vertebrae fuse into a single sacrum and coccyx, leaving 7 cervical, 12 thoracic, 5 lumbar, 1 sacrum and 1 coccyx.
questions.ncertReference: Biology Class 11, Chapter 17: Locomotion and Movement

questions.subject: Zoology
questions.question: Lactational amenorrhoea works as a natural method of contraception because:
options: Intense lactation suppresses the ovulation cycle, so conception is unlikely for up to about six months
It permanently blocks the fallopian tubes
It changes the mother's blood group
questions.explanation: The method has no side effects at all but works only while the mother breastfeeds fully and only for about the first six months after delivery.
